title: Hello Spring
author: Shelley Rotner

hero.name: Spring child (girl with magnifying glass)
hero.description: Generic child observing nature in spring — cover shows a real photograph of a child outdoors in spring setting
hero.source_note: Photo-illustrated book with no named character — use generic Boardmaker child/outside image

notes: Hello Spring is a photo-illustrated non-fiction picture book celebrating signs of spring — animals waking up, flowers blooming, rain and mud, sunshine and warmth. All 11 fringe words are already present in either activity_images or aac_extras, so no new icons need to be sourced. The hero slot uses a generic child-outdoors image since the book features real photographs of children rather than a named illustrated character. Words like 'snow', 'rainbow', 'puddle', 'boot', 'melt', 'cold', and 'outside' were considered but ranked lower in book centrality; the 11 chosen words appear most frequently and are most central to the spring theme. 'Bloom' is an action-as-noun that is highly picturable and book-specific.
